title: Strix launches AI-powered pentesting with live attacks and fix #strix #aipentesting #cybersecurity
description: Strix created a free and open source AI pentesting tool that uses specialized AI agents to simulate real hacker attacks on apps, websites, and projects. Instead of just listing vulnerabilities, it actively exploits each one and provides working proof with suggested fixes. Strix runs using your own AI model key, supporting models like Claude, GPT, Gemini, or local setups, minimizing costs to just the model usage. This approach shifts security testing from manual checklists to an automated, interactive AI-driven process. By enabling full security audits before deployment, Strix helps developers catch and fix holes early, improving software safety and reducing risks of exploitation in a rapidly evolving cybersecurity landscape. #Strix #AIPentesting #OpenSourceSecurity #AIHacking #CybersecurityTools #GitHubStars #ClaudeAI #GPT #GeminiAI #VulnerabilityTesting #SecurityAutomation #SoftwareSecurity #AIAgents #PenetrationTesting #DevSecOps
